title: What is NLP?
text: Natural language processing is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to process, understand, and generate human language.

title: Tokenization
text: Tokenization splits text into smaller units such as words, subwords, or sentences before further language processing.

title: TF-IDF
text: Term frequency inverse document frequency gives higher weight to words important in one document but uncommon across the collection.

title: Named entity recognition
text: Named entity recognition identifies names of people, organizations, locations, dates, and other entity categories in text.

title: Text classification
text: Text classification assigns a label to a document, such as spam or not spam, sentiment category, or topic.
